subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw make TUI-local shell results durable session state and define `!` as agent-visible while `!!` is excluded only from automatic context?
rationale: This creates a persistent, security-sensitive transcript and Gateway protocol convention rather than repairing an established documented behavior, and no maintainer has explicitly approved the permanent prefix or privacy semantics.

options.title: Sponsor with hard boundaries
options.body: Approve the capability only after the confidentiality wording or enforcement, fresh-session behavior, committed artifacts, and exact-head proof are corrected.

options.title: Adopt context-hygiene semantics
options.body: Explicitly accept that `!!` is persisted and omitted from automatic context but may remain visible through authorized history tools, with unambiguous user-facing language.

options.title: Keep shell commands ephemeral
options.body: Decline the durable protocol and retain the current per-process local-only shell behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor with hard boundaries
recommendation.body: Approve the capability only after the confidentiality wording or enforcement, fresh-session behavior, committed artifacts, and exact-head proof are corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current transcript-storage, Gateway, and TUI product boundaries associated with their recent work, and they are already subscribed to the PR.
